groups.label: Extraarticular
groups.description: Metaphyseal proximal tibia fracture without articular surface involvement.

variants.label: Avulsion / simple extraarticular
variants.description: Extraarticular avulsion or simple metaphyseal fracture with preserved joint surface.

variants.label: Metaphyseal wedge
variants.description: Extraarticular metaphyseal fracture with wedge fragment and maintained articular continuity.

variants.label: Metaphyseal complex
variants.description: Multifragmentary extraarticular proximal tibia fracture.

treatments.label: Nonoperative treatment
treatments.main_indications: Undisplaced stable fracture, poor surgical candidate, or low-demand patient with acceptable alignment.

treatments.label: Locking plate fixation
treatments.main_indications: Displaced metaphyseal fracture requiring restoration of alignment and stable fixation.

treatments.label: External fixation / staged fixation
treatments.main_indications: High-energy injury, severe soft-tissue swelling, open fracture, or temporary damage-control stabilization.

groups.label: Partial articular
groups.description: Partial articular fracture with part of the tibial plateau remaining attached to the shaft.

variants.label: Pure split
variants.description: Partial articular split pattern, commonly involving one plateau column.

variants.label: Split-depression
variants.description: Articular split with impacted depressed fragment requiring elevation and support.

variants.label: Pure depression
variants.description: Contained articular depression with intact metaphyseal shell.

treatments.label: Anterolateral plate fixation
treatments.main_indications: Lateral plateau split or split-depression requiring direct visualization, reduction, and buttress support.

treatments.label: Medial / posteromedial support
treatments.main_indications: Medial plateau or posteromedial fragment requiring buttress support and stable column fixation.

treatments.label: Arthroscopy-assisted reduction
treatments.main_indications: Selected depression patterns where joint assessment and minimally invasive elevation are appropriate.

groups.label: Complete articular
groups.description: Complete articular fracture separating the articular block from the tibial shaft.

variants.label: Simple articular, simple metaphysis
variants.description: Complete articular fracture with simple joint and metaphyseal components.

variants.label: Simple articular, multifragmentary metaphysis
variants.description: Simple articular split with metaphyseal comminution.

variants.label: Multifragmentary articular
variants.description: Complex bicondylar or multifragmentary plateau fracture.

treatments.label: Dual-column fixation
treatments.main_indications: Bicondylar instability requiring restoration of articular width, alignment, and column support.

treatments.label: Staged external / ring fixation
treatments.main_indications: High-energy bicondylar fracture with soft-tissue compromise or open injury.

treatments.label: Posteromedial fragment fixation
treatments.main_indications: Posteromedial shear fragment or posterior column instability requiring direct support.

groups.label: Simple
groups.description: Simple tibial shaft fracture with two main fragments.

variants.label: Spiral
variants.description: Simple spiral fracture, often low-energy torsional pattern.

variants.label: Oblique
variants.description: Simple oblique fracture with a single oblique fracture line.

variants.label: Transverse
variants.description: Simple transverse or short oblique shaft fracture.

treatments.label: Intramedullary nailing
treatments.main_indications: Most displaced adult tibial shaft fractures with acceptable soft-tissue envelope.

treatments.label: Cast / functional brace
treatments.main_indications: Stable minimally displaced pattern with reliable follow-up and acceptable alignment.

treatments.label: Plate fixation
treatments.main_indications: Fracture pattern unsuitable for nailing or requiring direct reduction.

groups.label: Wedge
groups.description: Tibial shaft fracture with wedge fragment and partial cortical contact.

variants.label: Spiral wedge
variants.description: Spiral wedge fragment with one intermediate fragment.

variants.label: Bending wedge
variants.description: Triangular bending wedge from direct or indirect force.

variants.label: Fragmented wedge
variants.description: Wedge pattern with additional fragmentation.

treatments.label: Locked intramedullary nail
treatments.main_indications: Length-unstable wedge fracture requiring locked fixation.

treatments.label: Minimally invasive plate osteosynthesis
treatments.main_indications: Metadiaphyseal extension, poor nail control, or fracture geometry favoring bridge plating.

treatments.label: External fixation
treatments.main_indications: Temporary or definitive stabilization for open fracture, severe soft tissue injury, or limited resources.

groups.label: Complex
groups.description: Multifragmentary tibial shaft fracture without simple cortical contact.

variants.label: Complex spiral
variants.description: Multifragmentary spiral shaft fracture.

variants.label: Segmental
variants.description: Segmental shaft fracture with separate intermediate segment.

variants.label: Irregular complex
variants.description: Highly comminuted tibial shaft fracture.

treatments.label: Bridge nailing
treatments.main_indications: Complex shaft fracture where indirect reduction preserves biology and restores length, rotation, and alignment.

treatments.label: Ring external fixator
treatments.main_indications: Open fracture, bone loss, infection risk, or severe soft-tissue injury requiring adjustable fixation.

treatments.label: Limited-resource fracture care
treatments.main_indications: Settings where advanced imaging or implant resources are limited.

groups.label: Extraarticular
groups.description: Distal tibial metaphyseal fracture without articular extension.

variants.label: Simple
variants.description: Simple extraarticular distal tibia fracture.

variants.label: Wedge
variants.description: Extraarticular distal metaphyseal fracture with wedge fragment.

variants.label: Complex
variants.description: Multifragmentary extraarticular distal tibia fracture.

treatments.label: Medial MIO plate fixation
treatments.main_indications: Distal metaphyseal fracture requiring bridge fixation with soft-tissue preservation.

treatments.label: Nailing with limited open reduction
treatments.main_indications: Selected distal metaphyseal fractures where nail alignment control is achievable.

treatments.label: External fixation
treatments.main_indications: Temporary stabilization for swelling, open injury, or staged pilon management.

groups.label: Partial articular
groups.description: Partial articular distal tibia fracture with part of plafond attached to the shaft.

variants.label: Split
variants.description: Partial articular split of the distal tibial plafond.

variants.label: Split-depression
variants.description: Partial articular split with impacted surface.

variants.label: Multifragmentary partial articular
variants.description: Complex partial articular distal tibia fracture.

treatments.label: Anteromedial ORIF
treatments.main_indications: Anterior or medial articular fragment requiring direct reduction and fixation.

treatments.label: Anterolateral ORIF
treatments.main_indications: Anterolateral or Chaput-type fragment requiring direct access and buttress support.

treatments.label: Posterolateral fixation
treatments.main_indications: Posterior plafond or posterolateral fragment requiring direct posterior support.

groups.label: Complete articular
groups.description: Complete articular pilon fracture separating the plafond from the shaft.

variants.label: Simple articular, simple metaphysis
variants.description: Complete articular distal tibia fracture with simple components.

variants.label: Simple articular, complex metaphysis
variants.description: Simple articular split with metaphyseal comminution.

variants.label: Multifragmentary articular
variants.description: Highly comminuted complete articular pilon fracture.

treatments.label: Staged pilon ORIF
treatments.main_indications: High-energy pilon fracture after swelling improves and soft tissues are suitable for definitive fixation.

treatments.label: Posteromedial support
treatments.main_indications: Posteromedial column instability or posterior articular fragment.

treatments.label: External fixation / limited internal fixation
treatments.main_indications: Severe soft-tissue injury, contamination, or patient factors making extensile ORIF unsafe.
